element_kinds.link: click lands on the target screen: its h1 equals the target's title (or matches its pattern); Back returns
element_kinds.row: a table row or list row that is one link: as link
element_kinds.cell: a square of the ClassGrid: as link (a child) or as button (a mark, on the confirm screen)
element_kinds.tab: changes the view in place; the address carries the tab; the h1 does not change
element_kinds.button: click produces the stated effect: a row written, a state chip changed, a redirect; the test asserts the effect in the database or the DOM
element_kinds.fold: a Details: closed by default unless stated; click opens it and its content is visible; click again closes; the main action is never inside it
element_kinds.filter: changes the rows and writes itself into the address; × clears one; Clear clears all; a reload keeps them
element_kinds.field: a form field with a label; empty when required shows the stated message and submits nothing
element_kinds.switch: a two-state control; the state is spoken (aria-checked) and shown as a word, never colour alone
element_kinds.child_name: not a control: text. The child's name, read from the pii schema at render time and joined by child_id, shown only where an element of this kind is listed. The test asserts the name is present and, on every other screen, absent; it is never in a URL, a log line, a state word or an analytics call
element_kinds.upload: accepts the stated file kinds; a wrong kind shows a message; a right one shows the file's name before anything is sent
element_kinds.peek: a button on a child (a name, a square, a row or a chip) that opens ChildPeek in place for that child; the address carries the Sr. No. (never a name); Escape or Close closes it and focus returns to the button; the peek's own 'Open the child' link is the only route to the child page from a list

generic_checks: Renders at 1440: the eyebrow (14 px or larger), one h1 equal to the title, a purpose line of at most 140 characters, exactly one main action, the trail, and the rail where the screen lists one; a screen marked `frame: bare` (sign in) shows the bare frame, its h1 and its main action only. At 400 px every screen passes a smoke test (it renders, one h1, no console error, no sideways scroll of the page); screens marked `phone_gate` also pass checks 2, 5, 6 and 9 at 400.

Completeness: the set of interactive controls in the main column and the rail (a, button, [role=button], summary, input, select) equals this screen's element list for the signed-in role: nothing extra, nothing missing. A control that does nothing on click (no address change, no DOM change, no request) fails. The bar's own controls are not part of any screen's count; they are driven once per run against the `bar` list in screens.json.

Navigation: every link and row lands on its target screen (h1 check) and Back returns to this screen with the same address; a link whose target is its own screen (paging, a tab) changes the address and Back restores it; each earlier step of the trail returns to that screen; the four doors on the bar open their first screen from here. A control whose target screen's slice is not in `merged_slices` is not drawn (it is not a dead link), and its test is `test.fixme` until that slice merges.

Roles: a control marked for one group is absent from the page for the other (the UI lane's test). The refusal of the write behind it is tested once per write route, in the lane that owns it (the database rules CP-3 and CP-4, or the route's own group check), not once per screen.

Keyboard: Tab reaches every control in reading order; Enter or Space activates it; the focused control shows a visible ring (outline at least 2 px); Escape closes an open Sheet or Dialog. Nothing is shown by hover alone.
Touch: on a `phone_gate` screen at 400 px every control is at least 44 × 44 px with at least 8 px to its neighbour.

Words: every state shown is a word from the STATES rows beside its icon, never colour alone; a child's name appears only on screens whose element list marks a `child_name` element, read from pii by child_id, and on no other screen; every name the test finds on a page is in `tests/fake-names.ts`, the one list of names in the repository (the repository is public: a real name fails the run, and no fixture, test or baseline holds any other); no name is in any address; 'educator' never 'teacher'; no page loads a script or font from a host other than the site's own.
Accessibility: axe reports no serious or critical violation at either width in light; in dark it runs only on the journey steps and on the `blocks` screen.
Empty: with the fixture's empty class or empty filter, the screen shows exactly its stated empty text and its next-step link, and no table head over no rows, no zero columns, no dash columns.

Themes: a screenshot in light at 1440 is committed as the baseline; the `blocks` screen and the journey steps are also committed in dark. Text contrast is measured by the token-pair script (UI-14) and by axe, not by sampling every page.

slices.waits_for: UI-13 (it can be built early and re-run after every slice)
slices.what: A script that generates docs/frontend/AS-BUILT.md from screens.json plus the last inventory-test run: the milestone document Nimish asked for, so he can see exactly what exists, what each screen's controls are, and what the checks reported. A test feeds the script a screens.json and a report with known results and asserts the exact numbers and lines in the output, including a failed check and a screen that does not exist.

Every slice's scope includes the line 'this slice's id is in `merged_slices` in screens.json and AS-BUILT.md is regenerated in the same pull request'; a test fails if a slice listed in `merged_slices` has a screen the inventory test could not open.
